scripts.dev: cd apps/backend && PORT=3000 npx tsx server.ts
scripts.build:frontend: cd packages/database && npx prisma generate && cd ../../apps/frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd packages/database && npx prisma generate && cd ../../apps/backend && npm run build
scripts.build:all: cd packages/database && npx prisma generate && cd ../../apps/frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: cd apps/frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && cd ../backend && npx tsc --noEmit
